caveat: The source papers, their main conclusions, and exploratory workbook structure were known before this protocol was frozen. This is a deterministic reproduction, stress-test, and model-discrimination protocol. It is not a blind preregistration and cannot create independent confirmation of the source authors' claims.
objective: Test whether a modular bacterial-flagellar-motor model reproduces observations across stator remodeling, motor switching, occupancy cooperativity, and whole-cell propulsion without pooling incompatible assays or upgrading fit to causal identity.

nonNegotiableClaimFence.fullParity: Full biological parity is false unless every required observational domain, live-measurement, independent-replication, and physical-model gate passes.
nonNegotiableClaimFence.activeInference: No fit establishes that a bacterium implements Active Inference. Biological Active Inference identity remains NOT_ESTABLISHED unless an intervention discriminates it from non-Active-Inference mechanisms.
nonNegotiableClaimFence.latentStates: Latent states are predictive constructs unless molecularly identified by an independent measurement.
nonNegotiableClaimFence.assaySeparation: A parameter is never shared across assays solely because it has the same informal name. Units, interventions, strains, loads, observation operators, and independence units must match first.
nonNegotiableClaimFence.compute: Every executable analysis in this protocol is deterministic CPU-only and uses no LLM or GPU at runtime.

evidenceTiers.meaning: Direct raw or cell/motor-level source artifact from the primary study
Primary-study source workbook containing plotted values or aggregates
Digitized or reanalyzed values carried by a later primary paper with explicit attribution
Narrative or table-only published constraint; not eligible as raw-data replication

models.equation: p(t,event|N)=sum_j w_j(N) exp[-(kPlus_N+kMinus_j)t] times the event-specific hazard
models.observationOperator: single-motor dwell duration, direction, censoring, and integer stator occupancy
speed-bin binding-rate estimate with reported standard error and event counts

models.equation: P(phi|J,mu)=Z^-1 exp[J sum_i phi_i phi_(i+1)+mu sum_i phi_i], phi_i in {0,1}, L=13
models.observationOperator: load-class probability mass over occupied stator counts

models.equation: A deterministic port of the published coarse-grained generator: local torque multiplies engaged-subunit conformation rates and rotor motion exchanges engaged and unengaged subunits
models.observationOperator: stationary engaged-state distribution plus CW-to-CCW and CCW-to-CW rates versus motor speed

models.equation: Published resistive-force-theory source predictions indexed by flagellar count
models.observationOperator: cell swimming speed and independently measured motor/flagellar rotation rate

splitAndUncertainty.noRowSplit: Training and validation are separated by motor/cell, condition, speed bin, or study. Time points from the same motor are never treated as independent replicates.
splitAndUncertainty.smallAggregatePolicy: For published aggregate tables, report finite-sample sensitivity and leave-one-condition-out results; do not invent sample sizes.
splitAndUncertainty.sourcePredictionPolicy: Predictions shipped with a source paper are labeled source reproduction, not independent validation.

gates.criterion: Every cached artifact matches its frozen SHA-256 and byte size; each ZIP passes CRC testing; every selected workbook sheet and MAT variable parses without non-finite values in required fields.

At least four direct primary-study artifact families, at least eight attributed experimental/model studies in total, at least four observation scales, and a conservative direct-artifact lower bound of 400 independent motors/cells.

On Ito 2021 20-Hz bins, leave-one-bin-out RMSE of M_ROTATION_GATE is at least 20% lower than a constant-rate baseline, both directional slopes are positive, and the fitted stall intercept is finite and nonnegative.

In Antani 2021 motor-level fluorescence, MotAB expression increases CheY signal with Welch p<0.001 and a 95% motor bootstrap interval for the mean difference entirely above zero; FliM and rotating-versus-stalled controls are reported and cannot be omitted.
Across Antani 2021 torque conditions, Spearman rho is at least 0.8 for both directional transition rates versus torque while the coefficient of variation of CW bias remains below 0.15.

The exact L=13 model jointly fitted to published 300/500/1300-nm occupancy distributions estimates 0.5<J<2.0, improves AIC by at least 10 over J=0, and has probability RMSE below 0.05. This can pass only as aggregate-source reproduction because motor heterogeneity is unavailable.

The ported M_GMC generator has nonnegative off-diagonal rates, column sums below 1e-10, stationary residual below 1e-9, and reproduces the published gamma=3.5 engaged-state marginal with L1 error below 0.03.

For both published Yuan 2009 switching directions inside the model speed support, at least 60% of source-model interpolants fall within the digitized asymmetric error bars and mean absolute standardized residual is below 1.0.
Lisevich 2025 source RFT predictions achieve cell-speed RMSE below 2.0 um/s and beat a constant-mean baseline; the 95% interval for motor-speed slope versus flagellar count includes zero.

At least one mechanistic parameterization frozen on one laboratory/study predicts a second laboratory's commensurate raw observations with a predeclared advantage over baselines. Source-paper predictions or unit-incompatible mappings do not count.
Every discrete mechanical state and allowed transition is mapped to published structural states or explicitly labeled phenomenological; geometry and state multiplicity conflicts are zero.
A preregistered intervention must distinguish an Active-Inference-specific causal prediction from matched kinetic, control, and non-equilibrium statistical-mechanics alternatives.
A calibrated instrument provides timestamped raw signal, uncertainty, prediction-before-outcome, and immutable audit linkage during the same live run.
A laboratory independent of the model authors reproduces the predeclared effects and releases raw data, calibration, exclusions, and analysis provenance.
The exported UNI physical model is fabricated, measured against dimensional tolerances, and its sensor-to-screen math trace is tested with real inputs.
X01 through X15 all pass without SOURCE_ONLY, NOT_ESTABLISHED, FAIL, or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL status.
